nonClaims: D10.1 does not retroactively change D10's NOT_SUPPORTED verdict or FAIL audit.
D10.1 does not validate perspective projection, subpixel resampling or deformation motion.
D10.1 excludes transparency, multi-owner pixels, volumetrics, hair, depth of field and motion blur.
D10.1 validates Object Index only for opaque single-owner pixels and does not validate Cryptomatte.
D10.1 does not run the D9.1 accumulator on real rendered beauty pixels and does not claim temporal image quality.
D10.1 does not claim cross-engine, cross-version, cross-operating-system or cross-GPU equivalence.
D10.1 does not claim cinematic quality or human preference.
